snippet.title: The NewZealand Story is Back!💛
snippet.description:
The bizarre and colorful world of Tiki now shines with a completely new look, while preserving the heart that first made us fall in love.

Faithfully recreated by Commodore Industries and Over The Game, in collaboration with the timeless magic of TAITO. 🕹​

Get ready to fly, fight, and smile: Tiki’s adventure has only just begun! 🐥​
